Article 4 (Qualifications, etc. of Evaluating Agencies)
A performance measurement and evaluation agency under Article 10 (1) of the Act (hereinafter referred to as an "evaluating agency") shall be a corporation that meets all of the following qualification and size requirements:
1. Qualifications: The corporation shall have completed at least one project or research activity related to performance measurement and evaluation within the preceding three years;
2. Size: The corporation shall employ at least two dedicated personnel meeting the requirements specified in the attached Table who are necessary for performing performance measurement and evaluation duties.
